items.quote: He cried out to the man of God who had come from Judah, “This is what the Lord says: ‘You have defied the word of the Lord
items.contrast: The man of God is the person accused of disobedience, while the old prophet is the speaker delivering the accusation.
items.reason: The old prophet addresses the man of God as “you” and says that he defied the Lord’s word. This resolves the possible confusion between the speaker and the person accused.
